hygieneDelta: Remove the orphaned shell/core/user/.spec/icon.svg left after the Shell module cut.
Retarget the workspace test:file fixture from the deleted Shell module to a current Shell-owned test.
Allow the temporal negative scan to skip tracked paths deleted in the worktree.
Exclude volatile verification durationMs values from verified transport digests.

cli.usage:
Usage:
  astrale-spec init [module-directory]
  astrale-spec check [root] [--select <relative-path>]... [--exclude <relative-path>]... [--require-complete-layout] [--require-exact-layout] [--quiet] [--no-cache]
  astrale-spec changed [root] [base] [--exclude <relative-path>]... [--require-complete-layout] [--scope-only] [--quiet] [--no-cache]
  astrale-spec test [module-path]... [--root <directory>] [--quiet] [--no-cache]
  astrale-spec test changed [base] [--root <directory>] [--quiet] [--no-cache]
  astrale-spec verify [root] [--select <relative-path>]... [--schema-root <directory>]... [--require-pass] [--details] [--quiet]
  astrale-spec dev [root] [--port <number>] [--open] [--verify] [--no-cache]
